items.name: icscheck
items.description: Free, open-source security audit tool for ICS/SCADA/HMI systems. IEC 62443 & NIS2 compliance.

items.name: 19-20_frripe
items.description: Tool to perform quantitative risk analysis and calculate Target Security Level (SL-T) according to methodology of IEC-62443.

items.name: COIT
items.description: This open-source tool translates any CVE into OT/ICS operational terms — Purdue levels, MITRE ATT&CK for ICS, IEC 62443, and plant-floor impact.

items.name: ICS_Network_Segmentation_Lab
items.description: A home lab project simulating IT / DMZ / OT network segmentation with pfSense, OpenPLC, and HMI systems. Includes firewall configs, ladder logic, and Python tools for Modbus/OT network testing. Built to demonstrate practical application of NIST 800-82 and IEC 62443 frameworks in securing industrial control systems.

items.name: security-UX-pattern-library
items.description: 36 interactive security UX patterns + 5 strategic tools. Compliance mapping for GDPR, NIS2, EU AI Act, DORA, IEC 62443 +++ — live at uxsec.dev

items.name: CyberOT
items.description: The OT Cybersecurity Maturity Assessment Tool is a comprehensive, interactive platform designed to help organizations evaluate, track, and improve their operational technology (OT) security posture. Built on industry-leading frameworks including IEC 62443 and NIST Cybersecurity Framework,

items.name: iec62443-audit
items.description: IEC 62443 security level assessment tool for ICS/SCADA — 62443-3-3 system & 62443-4-2 component checks, multi-zone, gap analysis, TUI.

items.name: CRA-IEC62443-SBOM
items.description: Open Finnish training material on the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), IEC 62443 industrial cybersecurity standards, and Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for OT and IIoT systems. Practical examples, exercises, and tools (Syft, Grype) for engineers preparing for CRA compliance.

items.name: iec62443-multitenant-blindspot-check
items.description: IEC 62443 NC-1/NC-2/NC-3 multi-tenant monitoring blind-spot evaluator. Companion tool to Kim (2026) 'Compliant Yet Blind'.
